title: Packages
description: Everything sold besides a base plan: one-off credit packs, recurring add-ons that raise an enforced entitlement, and coupons. Each item can be pushed to Stripe and checked against it.
sandboxNote: Stripe runs in its Sandbox on this platform — checkout sessions are cs_test_.
footerNote: Nothing is deleted here. Archiving takes an item off sale and deactivates its Stripe Product, Prices or promotion code; sold items keep their history. Stripe prices are immutable, so a price edit creates a new Price at the next sync and archives the old one.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, slug or code…

toasts.failed: The change could not be saved.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.descriptionPack: It stops being offered at once. Purchases already made keep their credits and history, and its Stripe Product and Prices are deactivated — never deleted.
archive.descriptionAddon: No new workspace can buy it. Workspaces already subscribed keep it until they cancel; its Stripe Product and Prices are deactivated — never deleted.
archive.descriptionCoupon: The code stops working at once and its Stripe promotion code is deactivated. Discounts already running on subscriptions continue as promised.
archive.restoreDescription: It comes back as a draft. Put it on sale again from the editor, and sync it to Stripe.
archive.failed: The change could not be saved.

stripe.title: Stripe — {name}
stripe.description: What Stripe holds for this item, and whether it still matches.
stripe.immutableNote: Stripe prices and coupon terms cannot be edited. A changed price creates a new Price and deactivates the old one; changed coupon terms create a new Stripe coupon. Nothing is deleted.
stripe.notConfigured: Stripe is not configured on this environment.
stripe.nothingToCompare: Nothing in Stripe to compare yet.
stripe.driftFound: {count, plural, one {# difference} other {# differences}} between the database and Stripe. Sync to push the database's values.

editor.saveError: The package could not be saved.
editor.noTargets: Nothing of the chosen types yet — the coupon applies to all of them.

pack.description: A one-off bundle of credits, added to the workspace balance when paid.

addon.description: A recurring extra on top of a plan, billed as its own Stripe subscription. Each unit raises one entitlement the product enforces.

coupon.description: A discount customers redeem with a code, or a campaign applied automatically.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Used in Stripe metadata.
fields.activeHint: Off keeps it as a draft nobody can buy.
fields.bonusHint: Granted on top of the credits, at no extra charge.
fields.validityHint: Empty: the credits never expire. Unspent pack credits are removed at expiry.
fields.priceHint: Empty: not sold in this currency.
fields.entitlementHint: Only entitlements the product enforces can be sold.
fields.grantLocked: Sold already — the grant is fixed. Duplicate to sell a different one.
fields.unitLabelHint: What a customer calls one unit, e.g. "participant".
fields.unitsPerQuantityHint: How much one unit raises the limit.
fields.codeHint: What customers type. Leave empty for an auto-apply campaign.
fields.autoApplyHint: Applied to every eligible checkout without a code; the best campaign wins.
fields.durationHint: For recurring purchases; one-off packs are discounted once.
fields.termsLocked: Redeemed already — the discount is fixed.
fields.stackingHint: One coupon per checkout: a typed code replaces any campaign, and coupons never stack.
fields.appliesToIdsHint: None selected: every item of the chosen types.

validation.slug: The slug is lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 60 characters.
validation.name: The name is required and at most 100 characters.
validation.description: The description is at most 500 characters.
validation.credits: Credits must be a whole number above 0.
validation.bonusCredits: Bonus credits must be a whole number, 0 or more.
validation.priceRequired: Set a price in at least one currency.
validation.pricePositive: {field}: the price must be more than 0.
validation.priceTwoDecimals: {field}: USD has at most two decimals.
validation.priceBelowStripeMinimum: {field}: below the smallest amount Stripe can charge ({minimum}).
validation.validity: Validity is 1 to 3,650 days, or empty.
validation.limitPositive: A limit is at least 1, or empty for none.
validation.limitOrder: The per-workspace limit cannot exceed the total limit.
validation.window: The start must be before the end.
validation.unitLabel: The unit name is required, at most 40 characters.
validation.entitlement: Choose an entitlement the product enforces.
validation.unitsPerQuantity: Adds per unit is a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
validation.capabilityOnce: A capability add-on is one unit, bought once.
validation.code: A code is 3–40 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
validation.codeOrAuto: Give the coupon a code, or make it an auto-apply campaign.
validation.percent: A percentage is more than 0 and at most 100.
validation.fixedCurrency: A fixed discount needs a currency.
validation.fixedAmount: A fixed discount is more than 0.
validation.appliesTo: Choose what the coupon applies to.
validation.months: Only a repeating coupon has months, from 1 to 36.
